FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.description: The essentials on investment, timelines, and how we work with you.

one.question: How much does a project cost?
one.answer: Pricing depends on scope and availability. After a conversation, we prepare a proposal with deliverables and terms. If the problem needs more definition, we quote that phase first. We bill in US dollars.

two.question: How long does a typical project take?
two.answer: We agree on timelines after defining scope and confirming availability. The proposal specifies deliverables and dates; we communicate the impact of risks or scope changes in writing.

three.question: What technologies do you work with?
three.answer: Mostly TypeScript across the stack: Next.js and React on the frontend, Node.js or Python on the backend, and Postgres for data. We pick the stack for your problem, not the other way around.

four.question: Who owns the code and IP after the project?
four.answer: Intellectual property ownership and usage rights are agreed in writing before each project starts. The contract defines what is transferred, what is licensed, and which components each party retains, together with handover and continuity terms. Attribution, such as “Developed by MuyuSoft,” and permission to feature the project in our portfolio are agreed separately.

five.question: How do we communicate during the project?
five.answer: We agree on a communication channel, a contact on each side, and a progress schedule. Decisions, risks, and scope changes are recorded in writing. We coordinate working hours from Ecuador.

six.question: Do you offer support after launch?
six.answer: The contract defines a warranty period for fixing defects attributable to our work at no extra cost. Maintenance and further development are agreed separately. We hand over documentation and access so another team can take over.

seven.question: How exactly do you use AI in your process?
seven.answer: We use AI to assist with code, tests, and documentation. A person reviews and takes responsibility for every change. Architecture and product decisions remain with the team, and quality checks run before delivery.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy policy
PrivacyPage.intro: The form collects your name, email, message, service of interest, and optional company and budget. The submission integration uses Web3Forms to process your inquiry. The site may enable Plausible Analytics when configured. For questions about your data, contact hello@muyusoft.com.
PrivacyPage.placeholderNotice: Provisional notice: the privacy policy, including retention, providers, and rights requests, still requires completion and review before final publication.

TermsPage.title: Terms of service
TermsPage.intro: This site describes our services and demonstrations. Each project’s scope, price, schedule, payments, warranty, intellectual property ownership, and usage rights are agreed in writing in its contract. Demonstrations use fictional scenarios and data.
TermsPage.placeholderNotice: Provisional notice: full website terms and contractual conditions are pending review. This summary does not replace each project’s agreement.

AiPolicyPage.title: AI policy
AiPolicyPage.intro: We use AI as a tool for our engineers, not a replacement for their judgment.
AiPolicyPage.practice: AI assists us with code, tests, and documentation. Every change is reviewed by a person who understands it and takes responsibility for it. Technical and product decisions remain the team’s responsibility.
AiPolicyPage.clientData: Our principle is to keep sensitive client information out of unapproved AI tools. The operational data and tools policy has yet to be finalized; it must define permitted information, approved tools, and review responsibilities before project data is introduced.
AiPolicyPage.updates: This policy may be updated as our tools and practices evolve.
